sentences.text:
This is a petition under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for short, 'Code') preferred by Lakhbir Singh- petitioner, seeking pre-arrest bail, feeling apprehension of his arrest, in Complaint No. 173, dated 23.10.2009, under Sections 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and under Rule 50 of the PFA Rules, 1955.
2.

It is an admitted fact that petitioner has already joined the proceedings before the ld. trial court in compliance of order passed by this Court on April 20, 2015 and has been released on interim bail at its satisfaction, vide order dated May 01, 2015.
Copy of the aforesaid order has been furnished by learned counsel for the CRM No.M-9904 of 2015 --2-- petitioner, during the course of arguments, which is taken on record.
